newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Commercial Bank of Zimbabwe to be privatised - paper.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Bank of Zimbabwe to be privatised - paper.

text.p: The Zimbabwe government has approved the privatisation of its Commercial Bank of Zimbabwe (CZB) and would reduce its holding in the bank to 20 percent, the state-owned Business Herald said on Thursday.
The paper said the move would boost the bank's share capital to Z$500 million.

CZB, an off-shoot of the Bank of Credit and Commerce International, has been hampered in its efforts to enhance its loan portfolio and increase its market share by severe limitations within its capital structure.
The government, as sole shareholder, could not adequately fund the bank because of budgetary constraints.
